services:
 
  neurosync:
    mem_limit: 12g
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: ./app/AVATAR/NeuroBridge/dockerfile  # Builds combined Local API + Player image
    container_name: neurosync_s1
    command: [/app/entrypoint_bridge.sh]
    ports:
      - "5000:5000" # Expose Flask API port
      - "5001:5001" # Expose Player HTTP Server port
    environment:
      - FLASK_HOST=0.0.0.0
      - PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
      - ALLOWED_ORIGINS=*
      - PLAYER_PORT=5001 # Set Player HTTP Server port
      # SCB storage
      - USE_REDIS_SCB=true
      - REDIS_URL=redis://redis:6379/0
      # - LIVELINK_UDP_IP=your_host_ip_address_here # Commented out to use default 'host.docker.internal'
      # Add other NeuroSync env vars as needed (e.g., USE_REDIS_SCB)
      # ---- LLM Provider (OpenAI) ----
      - LLM_PROVIDER=openai
      - OPENAI_MODEL=gpt-4o
      - OPENAI_API_KEY=${OPENAI_API_KEY}
      - VTUBER_PAYMENT_ENABLED=false
      # ======================================
      # Orchestrator Configuration
      # ======================================
      # Set orchestrator version (v2, v3, reactive)
      - ORCHESTRATOR_VERSION=reactive
      # Enable autonomous orchestration
      - AUTONOMOUS_ORCHESTRATION_ENABLED=true
      # Minimum idle time before generating autonomous content (seconds)
      - AUTONOMOUS_MIN_IDLE_TIME=5.0
      # Minimum gap between autonomous speeches (seconds)  
      - AUTONOMOUS_SPEECH_GAP=2.0
      # How often to check if should generate content (seconds)
      - DECISION_LOOP_INTERVAL=0.5
      # Thresholds for different types of content (seconds)
      - IDLE_AMBIENT_THRESHOLD=5.0
      - IDLE_CONTINUATION_THRESHOLD=5.0
      - IDLE_ENGAGING_THRESHOLD=5.0
      # Maximum characters for autonomous generated content
      - AUTONOMOUS_MAX_CHARS=350
    deploy: # Add deploy configuration for GPU access
      resources:
        reservations:
          devices:
            - driver: nvidia
              count: 1 # or 'all'
              capabilities: [gpu]
    networks:
      - scb_bridge_net
    volumes:
      # Mount NeuroBridge code for live editing (optional)
      - ./app/AVATAR/NeuroBridge:/app/NeuroBridge
    env_file:
      - .env
    # Default CMD in image already starts Flask + client
    # Add healthcheck if desired
    # healthcheck:
    #   test: ["CMD", "curl", "--fail", "http://localhost:5000/scb/ping"]
    #   interval: 30s
    #   timeout: 10s
    #   retries: 3
    depends_on:
      - redis
      - vtuber-ollama
  redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    container_name: redis_scb
    ports:
      - "6379:6379"
    volumes:
      - redis_data:/data
    networks:
      - scb_bridge_net
    restart: unless-stopped

  nginx-rtmp:
    build:
      context: ./docker/files_docker_rtmp/docker/rtmp
    container_name: nginx_rtmp
    ports:
      - "1935:1935"   # RTMP ingest
      - "8080:8080"   # HLS + status page & HLS manifest
    volumes:
      - ./docker/files_docker_rtmp/docker/rtmp/nginx.conf:/etc/nginx/nginx.conf:ro
    networks:
      - scb_bridge_net
    restart: unless-stopped

  # PostgreSQL with pgvector for AutoGen
  postgres:
    image: ankane/pgvector:latest
    container_name: autogen_postgres
    environment:
      - POSTGRES_PASSWORD=postgres
      - POSTGRES_USER=postgres
      - POSTGRES_DB=autonomous_agent
    volumes:
      - autonomous_postgres_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    ports:
      - "5434:5432"
    restart: unless-stopped
    networks:
      - scb_bridge_net
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U postgres"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5

  # AutoGen agent with intelligent tool selection
  autogen_agent:
    build:
      context: ./app/CORE/autogen-agent
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    container_name: autogen_agent
    volumes:
      - ./app/CORE/autogen-agent/autogen_agent:/app/autogen_agent
    environment:
      - DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:postgres@postgres:5432/autonomous_agent
      - USE_COGNITIVE_ENHANCEMENT=true
      - STANDALONE_MODE=true
      - LOOP_INTERVAL=30
      - LOG_LEVEL=INFO
      - PORT=8000
      # Ollama configuration for local LLM - Use shared vtuber-ollama
      - OLLAMA_HOST=http://vtuber-ollama:11434
      - USE_OLLAMA=true
      - OLLAMA_MODEL=llama3.1:8b  # For AutoGen direct Ollama usage (with :8b)
      # VTuber integration with NeuroSync
      - VTUBER_ENDPOINT_URL=http://neurosync:5001/process_text
      # OpenAI fallback for Darwin-Gödel (from .env file)
      - OPENAI_API_KEY=${OPENAI_API_KEY}
      - OPENAI_MODEL=gpt-4o-mini
      # Cognee + Ollama Configuration (with Fastembed for embeddings)
      - LLM_PROVIDER=ollama
      - LLM_MODEL=llama3.1
      - COGNEE_LLM_MODEL=llama3.1  # For Cognee/LiteLLM (now works with alias)
      - LLM_API_KEY=ollama
      - LLM_ENDPOINT=http://vtuber-ollama:11434/v1
      - LLM_TEMPERATURE=0.1
      - LLM_MAX_TOKENS=2048
      # Use Fastembed for embeddings (recommended for codegraph pipeline per docs)
      - EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=fastembed
      - EMBEDDING_MODEL=sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2
      - EMBEDDING_DIMENSIONS=384
      - EMBEDDING_MAX_TOKENS=256
      - HUGGINGFACE_TOKENIZER=sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2  # Same as embedding model for Fastembed
      # Disable problematic settings
      - COGNEE_SUMMARIZATION_ENABLED=false
      - COGNEE_DISABLE_BACKGROUND_TASKS=true
      - INSTRUCTOR_MODE=json_mode
      - INSTRUCTOR_MAX_RETRIES=1
      # Evolution Configuration - Enable Real Modifications
      - DARWIN_GODEL_REAL_MODIFICATIONS=true
      - DARWIN_GODEL_REQUIRE_APPROVAL=false
      - DARWIN_GODEL_PERFORMANCE_THRESHOLD=10
      - DARWIN_GODEL_BACKUP_RETENTION_DAYS=30
      - DARWIN_GODEL_MAX_MODIFICATIONS_PER_CYCLE=3
      # AutoGen Continuous Loop Configuration
      - MAX_CONSECUTIVE_AUTO_REPLY=10  # Increase from default 4
      - MAX_ROUNDS=20                  # Increase conversation rounds
      - ENABLE_CONTINUOUS_EVOLUTION=true
      # Statistics Persistence Configuration
      - STATISTICS_PERSISTENCE_ENABLED=true
      - STATISTICS_RETENTION_DAYS=90
      - STATISTICS_BATCH_SIZE=100
      - CONVERSATION_STORAGE_ENABLED=true
      # Cognee Long-term Storage (when available)
      - COGNEE_LONG_TERM_STORAGE=true
      - COGNEE_CONVERSATION_STORAGE=true
      - COGNEE_PATTERN_LEARNING=true
    env_file:
      - .env  # ADD THIS - Critical for OpenAI API key access
    ports:
      - "8200:8000"
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      vtuber-ollama:
        condition: service_healthy  # Wait for Ollama to be fully ready
      ollama-loader:
        condition: service_completed_successfully  # Wait for model to be loaded
    restart: unless-stopped
    networks:
      - scb_bridge_net  # Same network as other services
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "curl", "-f", "http://localhost:8000/health"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3


  # Ollama model loader - pulls models after Ollama is ready
  ollama-loader:
    image: curlimages/curl:latest
    container_name: ollama_loader
    depends_on:
      - vtuber-ollama
    networks:
      - scb_bridge_net
    entrypoint: >
      sh -c "
        echo 'Waiting for Ollama to be ready...' &&
        sleep 10 &&
        echo 'Pulling llama3.1:8b model for AutoGen...' &&
        curl -X POST http://vtuber-ollama:11434/api/pull -d '{\"name\": \"llama3.1:8b\"}' &&
        echo 'Pulling nomic-embed-text model for Cognee embeddings...' &&
        curl -X POST http://vtuber-ollama:11434/api/pull -d '{\"name\": \"nomic-embed-text:latest\"}' &&
        echo 'Models pull initiated' &&
        sleep 120 &&
        echo 'Loading llama3.1:8b model into memory...' &&
        curl -X POST http://vtuber-ollama:11434/api/generate -d '{\"model\": \"llama3.1:8b\", \"prompt\": \"Hello\", \"stream\": false}' &&
        echo 'Model loaded successfully'
      "
    restart: "no"

# -------------------------
# Local LLM Provider (Ollama) - Enhanced with GPU support
# -------------------------
  vtuber-ollama:
    image: ollama/ollama:latest
    container_name: vtuber-ollama
    runtime: nvidia
    ports:
      - "11434:11434"   # Ollama API
    volumes:
      - ollama_data:/root/.ollama   # Persist models between restarts
    environment:
      - OLLAMA_ORIGINS=*
      - NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=all
      - NVIDIA_DRIVER_CAPABILITIES=compute,utility
    deploy:
      resources:
        reservations:
          devices:
            - driver: nvidia
              count: all
              capabilities: [gpu]
    networks:
      - scb_bridge_net
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "ollama", "list"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 5

networks:
  scb_bridge_net:
    driver: bridge

volumes:
  redis_data:
    driver: local
  ollama_data:
    driver: local
  autonomous_postgres_data:
    driver: local

services:
  # GraphFlow Gateway - New System
  graphflow-gateway:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: docker/Dockerfile
    ports:
      - "8080:8080"  # GraphFlow API port
    environment:
      # Core settings
      - GRAPHFLOW_LOG_LEVEL=INFO
      - GRAPHFLOW_MAX_CONCURRENT_STIMULI=50
      - GRAPHFLOW_PROCESSING_TIMEOUT=30.0
      
      # LLM settings (using existing Ollama)
      - GRAPHFLOW_LLM_PROVIDER=ollama
      - GRAPHFLOW_LLM_MODEL=llama3.1:8b
      - GRAPHFLOW_LLM_ENDPOINT=http://host.docker.internal:11434
      
      # Integration with existing systems
      - SYSTEM1_VTUBER_ENDPOINT=http://host.docker.internal:5001
      - SYSTEM2_AUTOGEN_ENDPOINT=http://host.docker.internal:8200
      
      # Database connections
      - REDIS_URL=redis://redis:6379
      - POSTGRES_URL=postgresql://postgres:graphflow123@postgres:5432/graphflow
      
      # Monitoring
      - METRICS_ENABLED=true
      - PROMETHEUS_PORT=9090
      - DETAILED_LOGGING=true
      
      # Security
      - API_KEYS_FILE=/app/config/api_keys.json
      - RATE_LIMIT_REQUESTS_PER_MINUTE=60
      
    volumes:
      - ./config:/app/config
      - ./logs:/app/logs
    depends_on:
      - redis
      - postgres
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "curl", "-f", "http://localhost:8080/health"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
    restart: unless-stopped
    networks:
      - graphflow-network
      - default

  # Redis for state management and caching
  redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    ports:
      - "6380:6379"  # Different port to avoid conflicts
    volumes:
      - redis_data:/data
    command: redis-server --appendonly yes
    restart: unless-stopped
    networks:
      - graphflow-network

  # PostgreSQL for persistent storage
  postgres:
    image: postgres:15-alpine
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: graphflow
      POSTGRES_USER: postgres
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: graphflow123
      POSTGRES_INITDB_ARGS: "--encoding=UTF-8"
    volumes:
      - postgres_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
      - ./docker/init-db.sql:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/init-db.sql
    ports:
      - "5433:5432"  # Different port to avoid conflicts
    restart: unless-stopped
    networks:
      - graphflow-network

  # Prometheus for metrics collection
  prometheus:
    image: prom/prometheus:latest
    ports:
      - "9091:9090"  # Different port to avoid conflicts
    volumes:
      - ./monitoring/prometheus.yml:/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml
      - prometheus_data:/prometheus
    command:
      - '--config.file=/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml'
      - '--storage.tsdb.path=/prometheus'
      - '--web.console.libraries=/etc/prometheus/console_libraries'
      - '--web.console.templates=/etc/prometheus/consoles'
      - '--storage.tsdb.retention.time=200h'
      - '--web.enable-lifecycle'
    restart: unless-stopped
    networks:
      - graphflow-network

  # Grafana for monitoring dashboard
  grafana:
    image: grafana/grafana:latest
    ports:
      - "3001:3000"  # Different port to avoid conflicts
    environment:
      - GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_PASSWORD=admin
    volumes:
      - grafana_data:/var/lib/grafana
      - ./monitoring/grafana/dashboards:/etc/grafana/provisioning/dashboards
      - ./monitoring/grafana/datasources:/etc/grafana/provisioning/datasources
    restart: unless-stopped
    networks:
      - graphflow-network

  # Test client for sending stimuli
  test-client:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: docker/Dockerfile.test-client
    environment:
      - GRAPHFLOW_ENDPOINT=http://graphflow-gateway:8080
      - API_KEY=test_api_key_123
    volumes:
      - ./tests/data:/app/test_data
    depends_on:
      - graphflow-gateway
    profiles:
      - testing
    networks:
      - graphflow-network

volumes:
  redis_data:
    driver: local
  postgres_data:
    driver: local
  prometheus_data:
    driver: local
  grafana_data:
    driver: local

networks:
  graphflow-network:
    driver: bridge
    ipam:
      config:
        - subnet: 172.20.0.0/16

services:
  # GraphFlow Gateway - New System
  graphflow-gateway:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: docker/Dockerfile
    ports:
      - "8080:8080"  # GraphFlow API port
    environment:
      # Core settings
      - GRAPHFLOW_LOG_LEVEL=INFO
      - GRAPHFLOW_MAX_CONCURRENT_STIMULI=50
      - GRAPHFLOW_PROCESSING_TIMEOUT=30.0
      
      # LLM settings (using existing Ollama)
      - GRAPHFLOW_LLM_PROVIDER=ollama
      - GRAPHFLOW_LLM_MODEL=llama3.1:8b
      - GRAPHFLOW_LLM_ENDPOINT=http://host.docker.internal:11434
      
      # Integration with existing systems
      - SYSTEM1_VTUBER_ENDPOINT=http://host.docker.internal:5001
      - SYSTEM2_AUTOGEN_ENDPOINT=http://host.docker.internal:8200
      
      # Database connections
      - REDIS_URL=redis://redis:6379
      - POSTGRES_URL=postgresql://postgres:graphflow123@postgres:5432/graphflow
      
      # Monitoring
      - METRICS_ENABLED=true
      - PROMETHEUS_PORT=9090
      - DETAILED_LOGGING=true
      
      # Security
      - API_KEYS_FILE=/app/config/api_keys.json
      - RATE_LIMIT_REQUESTS_PER_MINUTE=60
      
    volumes:
      - ./config:/app/config
      - ./logs:/app/logs
    depends_on:
      - redis
      - postgres
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "curl", "-f", "http://localhost:8080/health"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
    restart: unless-stopped
    networks:
      - graphflow-network
      - default

  # Redis for state management and caching
  redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    ports:
      - "6380:6379"  # Different port to avoid conflicts
    volumes:
      - redis_data:/data
    command: redis-server --appendonly yes
    restart: unless-stopped
    networks:
      - graphflow-network

  # PostgreSQL for persistent storage
  postgres:
    image: postgres:15-alpine
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: graphflow
      POSTGRES_USER: postgres
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: graphflow123
      POSTGRES_INITDB_ARGS: "--encoding=UTF-8"
    volumes:
      - postgres_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
      - ./docker/init-db.sql:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/init-db.sql
    ports:
      - "5433:5432"  # Different port to avoid conflicts
    restart: unless-stopped
    networks:
      - graphflow-network

  # Prometheus for metrics collection
  prometheus:
    image: prom/prometheus:latest
    ports:
      - "9091:9090"  # Different port to avoid conflicts
    volumes:
      - ./monitoring/prometheus.yml:/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml
      - prometheus_data:/prometheus
    command:
      - '--config.file=/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml'
      - '--storage.tsdb.path=/prometheus'
      - '--web.console.libraries=/etc/prometheus/console_libraries'
      - '--web.console.templates=/etc/prometheus/consoles'
      - '--storage.tsdb.retention.time=200h'
      - '--web.enable-lifecycle'
    restart: unless-stopped
    networks:
      - graphflow-network

  # Grafana for monitoring dashboard
  grafana:
    image: grafana/grafana:latest
    ports:
      - "3001:3000"  # Different port to avoid conflicts
    environment:
      - GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_PASSWORD=admin
    volumes:
      - grafana_data:/var/lib/grafana
      - ./monitoring/grafana/dashboards:/etc/grafana/provisioning/dashboards
      - ./monitoring/grafana/datasources:/etc/grafana/provisioning/datasources
    restart: unless-stopped
    networks:
      - graphflow-network

  # Test client for sending stimuli
  test-client:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: docker/Dockerfile.test-client
    environment:
      - GRAPHFLOW_ENDPOINT=http://graphflow-gateway:8080
      - API_KEY=test_api_key_123
    volumes:
      - ./tests/data:/app/test_data
    depends_on:
      - graphflow-gateway
    profiles:
      - testing
    networks:
      - graphflow-network

volumes:
  redis_data:
    driver: local
  postgres_data:
    driver: local
  prometheus_data:
    driver: local
  grafana_data:
    driver: local

networks:
  graphflow-network:
    driver: bridge
    ipam:
      config:
        - subnet: 172.20.0.0/16

# Development override file usage:
# docker-compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up

services:
 
  neurosync:
    mem_limit: 12g
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: ./app/AVATAR/NeuroBridge/dockerfile  # Builds combined Local API + Player image
    container_name: neurosync_s1
    command: [/app/entrypoint_bridge.sh]
    ports:
      - "5000:5000" # Expose Flask API port
      - "5001:5001" # Expose Player HTTP Server port
    environment:
      - FLASK_HOST=0.0.0.0
      - PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
      - ALLOWED_ORIGINS=*
      - PLAYER_PORT=5001 # Set Player HTTP Server port
      # SCB storage
      - USE_REDIS_SCB=true
      - REDIS_URL=redis://redis:6379/0
      # - LIVELINK_UDP_IP=your_host_ip_address_here # Commented out to use default 'host.docker.internal'
      # Add other NeuroSync env vars as needed (e.g., USE_REDIS_SCB)
      # ---- LLM Provider (OpenAI) ----
      - LLM_PROVIDER=openai
      - OPENAI_MODEL=gpt-4o
      - OPENAI_API_KEY=${OPENAI_API_KEY}
      - VTUBER_PAYMENT_ENABLED=false
      # ======================================
      # Orchestrator Configuration
      # ======================================
      # Set orchestrator version (v2, v3, reactive)
      - ORCHESTRATOR_VERSION=reactive
      # Enable autonomous orchestration
      - AUTONOMOUS_ORCHESTRATION_ENABLED=true
      # Minimum idle time before generating autonomous content (seconds)
      - AUTONOMOUS_MIN_IDLE_TIME=5.0
      # Minimum gap between autonomous speeches (seconds)  
      - AUTONOMOUS_SPEECH_GAP=2.0
      # How often to check if should generate content (seconds)
      - DECISION_LOOP_INTERVAL=0.5
      # Thresholds for different types of content (seconds)
      - IDLE_AMBIENT_THRESHOLD=5.0
      - IDLE_CONTINUATION_THRESHOLD=5.0
      - IDLE_ENGAGING_THRESHOLD=5.0
      # Maximum characters for autonomous generated content
      - AUTONOMOUS_MAX_CHARS=350
    deploy: # Add deploy configuration for GPU access
      resources:
        reservations:
          devices:
            - driver: nvidia
              count: 1 # or 'all'
              capabilities: [gpu]
    networks:
      - scb_bridge_net
    volumes:
      # Mount NeuroBridge code for live editing (optional)
      - ./app/AVATAR/NeuroBridge:/app/NeuroBridge
    env_file:
      - .env
    # Default CMD in image already starts Flask + client
    # Add healthcheck if desired
    # healthcheck:
    #   test: ["CMD", "curl", "--fail", "http://localhost:5000/scb/ping"]
    #   interval: 30s
    #   timeout: 10s
    #   retries: 3
    depends_on:
      - redis
      - vtuber-ollama
  redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    container_name: redis_scb
    ports:
      - "6379:6379"
    volumes:
      - redis_data:/data
    networks:
      - scb_bridge_net
    restart: unless-stopped

  nginx-rtmp:
    build:
      context: ./docker/files_docker_rtmp/docker/rtmp
    container_name: nginx_rtmp
    ports:
      - "1935:1935"   # RTMP ingest
      - "8080:8080"   # HLS + status page & HLS manifest
    volumes:
      - ./docker/files_docker_rtmp/docker/rtmp/nginx.conf:/etc/nginx/nginx.conf:ro
    networks:
      - scb_bridge_net
    restart: unless-stopped

  # PostgreSQL with pgvector for AutoGen
  postgres:
    image: ankane/pgvector:latest
    container_name: autogen_postgres
    environment:
      - POSTGRES_PASSWORD=postgres
      - POSTGRES_USER=postgres
      - POSTGRES_DB=autonomous_agent
    volumes:
      - autonomous_postgres_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    ports:
      - "5434:5432"
    restart: unless-stopped
    networks:
      - scb_bridge_net
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U postgres"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5

  # AutoGen agent with intelligent tool selection
  autogen_agent:
    build:
      context: ./app/CORE/autogen-agent
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    container_name: autogen_agent
    volumes:
      - ./app/CORE/autogen-agent/autogen_agent:/app/autogen_agent
    environment:
      - DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:postgres@postgres:5432/autonomous_agent
      - USE_COGNITIVE_ENHANCEMENT=true
      - USE_AUTOGEN_LLM=true
      - STANDALONE_MODE=true
      - LOOP_INTERVAL=30
      - LOG_LEVEL=INFO
      - PORT=8000
      # Ollama configuration for local LLM - Use shared vtuber-ollama
      - OLLAMA_HOST=http://vtuber-ollama:11434
      - USE_OLLAMA=true
      - OLLAMA_MODEL=llama3.1:8b  # For AutoGen direct Ollama usage (with :8b)
      # VTuber integration with NeuroSync
      - VTUBER_ENDPOINT_URL=http://neurosync:5001/process_text
      # OpenAI fallback for Darwin-Gödel (from .env file)
      - OPENAI_API_KEY=${OPENAI_API_KEY}
      - OPENAI_MODEL=gpt-4o-mini
      # Cognee + Ollama Configuration (with Fastembed for embeddings)
      - LLM_PROVIDER=ollama
      - LLM_MODEL=llama3.1
      - COGNEE_LLM_MODEL=llama3.1  # For Cognee/LiteLLM (now works with alias)
      - LLM_API_KEY=ollama
      - LLM_ENDPOINT=http://vtuber-ollama:11434/v1
      - LLM_TEMPERATURE=0.1
      - LLM_MAX_TOKENS=2048
      # Use Fastembed for embeddings (recommended for codegraph pipeline per docs)
      - EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=fastembed
      - EMBEDDING_MODEL=sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2
      - EMBEDDING_DIMENSIONS=384
      - EMBEDDING_MAX_TOKENS=256
      - HUGGINGFACE_TOKENIZER=sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2  # Same as embedding model for Fastembed
      # Disable problematic settings
      - COGNEE_SUMMARIZATION_ENABLED=false
      - COGNEE_DISABLE_BACKGROUND_TASKS=true
      - INSTRUCTOR_MODE=json_mode
      - INSTRUCTOR_MAX_RETRIES=1
      # Evolution Configuration - Enable Real Modifications
      - DARWIN_GODEL_REAL_MODIFICATIONS=true
      - DARWIN_GODEL_REQUIRE_APPROVAL=false
      - DARWIN_GODEL_PERFORMANCE_THRESHOLD=10
      - DARWIN_GODEL_BACKUP_RETENTION_DAYS=30
      - DARWIN_GODEL_MAX_MODIFICATIONS_PER_CYCLE=3
      # AutoGen Continuous Loop Configuration
      - MAX_CONSECUTIVE_AUTO_REPLY=10  # Increase from default 4
      - MAX_ROUNDS=20                  # Increase conversation rounds
      - ENABLE_CONTINUOUS_EVOLUTION=true
      # Statistics Persistence Configuration
      - STATISTICS_PERSISTENCE_ENABLED=true
      - STATISTICS_RETENTION_DAYS=90
      - STATISTICS_BATCH_SIZE=100
      - CONVERSATION_STORAGE_ENABLED=true
      # Cognee Long-term Storage (when available)
      - COGNEE_LONG_TERM_STORAGE=true
      - COGNEE_CONVERSATION_STORAGE=true
      - COGNEE_PATTERN_LEARNING=true
    env_file:
      - .env  # ADD THIS - Critical for OpenAI API key access
    ports:
      - "8200:8000"
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      vtuber-ollama:
        condition: service_healthy  # Wait for Ollama to be fully ready
      ollama-loader:
        condition: service_completed_successfully  # Wait for model to be loaded
    restart: unless-stopped
    networks:
      - scb_bridge_net  # Same network as other services
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "curl", "-f", "http://localhost:8000/health"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3


  # Ollama model loader - pulls models after Ollama is ready
  ollama-loader:
    image: curlimages/curl:latest
    container_name: ollama_loader
    depends_on:
      - vtuber-ollama
    networks:
      - scb_bridge_net
    entrypoint: >
      sh -c "
        echo 'Waiting for Ollama to be ready...' &&
        sleep 10 &&
        echo 'Pulling llama3.1:8b model for AutoGen...' &&
        curl -X POST http://vtuber-ollama:11434/api/pull -d '{\"name\": \"llama3.1:8b\"}' &&
        echo 'Pulling nomic-embed-text model for Cognee embeddings...' &&
        curl -X POST http://vtuber-ollama:11434/api/pull -d '{\"name\": \"nomic-embed-text:latest\"}' &&
        echo 'Models pull initiated' &&
        sleep 120 &&
        echo 'Loading llama3.1:8b model into memory...' &&
        curl -X POST http://vtuber-ollama:11434/api/generate -d '{\"model\": \"llama3.1:8b\", \"prompt\": \"Hello\", \"stream\": false}' &&
        echo 'Model loaded successfully'
      "
    restart: "no"

# -------------------------
# Local LLM Provider (Ollama) - Enhanced with GPU support
# -------------------------
  vtuber-ollama:
    image: ollama/ollama:latest
    container_name: vtuber-ollama
    runtime: nvidia
    ports:
      - "11434:11434"   # Ollama API
    volumes:
      - ollama_data:/root/.ollama   # Persist models between restarts
    environment:
      - OLLAMA_ORIGINS=*
      - NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=all
      - NVIDIA_DRIVER_CAPABILITIES=compute,utility
    deploy:
      resources:
        reservations:
          devices:
            - driver: nvidia
              count: all
              capabilities: [gpu]
    networks:
      - scb_bridge_net
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "ollama", "list"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 5

networks:
  scb_bridge_net:
    driver: bridge

volumes:
  redis_data:
    driver: local
  ollama_data:
    driver: local
  autonomous_postgres_data:
    driver: local
